title: 面向企业AI智能体部署前保障的本体驱动仿真与信任认证框架
summary: 提出首个结合本体驱动仿真与信任认证的企业AI智能体预部署验证框架，通过Agent运行包络、本体到场景生成流水线及可验证信任证书，在金融、银行、保险、医疗等受监管行业显著提升监管覆盖率（48.3% vs 33.1%），为生产部署提供可审计的保障门控。
summary_en: Proposes the first ontology-grounded verification framework for pre-deployment assurance of enterprise AI agents, combining Agent Operational Envelope, ontology-to-scenario generation pipeline, and verifiable Trust Certificate. Achieves 48.3% regulatory coverage vs 33.1% baseline in regulated industries (Fintech, Banking, Insurance, Healthcare).
